Name: (CP) Dacar Stardew Valley Expanded anime style portraits
Author: DacarTheGorilla
Description:
[color=#00ff00][b]**--Instructions for 1.6 CP for Portaiture--*[/b][/color]
[color=#00ff00][b]Just download the mod and put it in the mods folder.
In order to see the portraits you'll need Portraiture and do one of this two things:
-Once inside the game press "P" (by default it may be different depending on your settings) until you see HDP
-In Portraiture config setting  change this to not have to cycle through your portraits:
"active": "HDP"[/b][/color]


 As I have completed all my main goals I'll start with the seasonals, it may take some time but I'll try to do them as fast as I can!

[b]Added in 2.1.1[/b]
New toggles and Claire's changes
[spoiler]Now you can change Susan's hairstyle and see Claire's portrait changes in this version too![img]https://i.postimg.cc/k5ZV8VSx/All-In-One-SVEOther-Toggles.png[/img][/spoiler]

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/6509pQY9/Next-Projects.png[/img]
